summary: This RFC creates an IANA registry called "Post-Stack First Nibble" for the first 4 bits immediately after an MPLS label stack. It also sets requirements for registering new values, so MPLS packet processing is easier and more robust.

eli5.summary: Right after the address labels, the first few bits tell what comes next. This makes an official list of what each value means so devices don't confuse them.

questions: mpls first nibble after label stack
